name: copilot-pulse-vscode
description: ⚡ Intelligent Model Router & Savings Engine for GitHub Copilot in VS Code

chatParticipants.name: copilotpulse
chatParticipants.description: ⚡ Autonomous Model Router & Agent: Dynamically analyzes prompt & context, routes to the optimal LLM (Light/Medium/Heavy), and executes tool/function calling seamlessly.

commands.title: Copilot Pulse: Show Supported Models & Tiers

copilotPulse.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. OpenRouter).

copilotPulse.apiKey.description: API Key for your OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint.

copilotPulse.cheapModel.description: Model to use for low/medium complexity prompts.

copilotPulse.strongModel.description: Model to use for high complexity prompts.

copilotPulse.useDynamicTiers.description: Dynamically route across all models available on your provider.

copilotPulse.routing.v2.description: Use the context-aware routing engine (conversation stickiness, attachment/structure signals, tool-aware tiering). Disable to fall back to the legacy keyword-only scorer.

copilotPulse.routing.stickiness.description: How much complexity a conversation may shed per turn (~2.5 = one tier). Higher values make routing drop back to cheaper models faster on short follow-ups.

copilotPulse.maxAgentTurns.description: Maximum tool round-trips the @copilotpulse agent performs before pausing and asking you to continue.

copilotPulse.escalation.enabled.description: Automatically retry on a stronger model when the selected model cannot complete the task.

copilotPulse.escalation.maxEscalationsPe.description: Cost guard: maximum number of tier escalations allowed within a single conversation.

copilotPulse.escalation.stuckLoopThresho.description: Consecutive identical tool calls before the agent is considered stuck and is escalated.

copilotPulse.escalation.toolErrorThresho.description: Consecutive tool failures before escalating to a stronger model.

copilotPulse.escalation.triggers.description: Which failure signals are allowed to trigger an automatic escalation.

scripts.test:all: node test_ask_and_agent_modes.mjs && node src/test/comprehensive.test.mjs && node test_agent_tools.mjs && node test_proxy_routing.js && node test_sse_fragmentation.js && node test_abrupt_stop.js && node test_routing_v2.js && node test_agent_escalation.mjs && node test_byok_gating.js && node test_proxy_robustness.js && node test_prerelease.mjs && node test_agent_long_task.mjs
